name: GoPay

evidence.gateway: F02: payment gateway; not a merchant of record, the merchant sells directly
evidence.billing: F14: automatic recurring card charges after buyer authorization; F15: fixed intervals
evidence.links: F16: a payment link or button can be generated in the merchant account and sent to a buyer
evidence.crypto: C01: buyers can pay in Bitcoin; C02: GoPay converts it and credits fiat to the merchant

line: Czech and Slovak gateway for online payments and recurring cards.

free.text: Start: 12 months with free card volume up to CZK 50,000/month

cells.countries: Czechia and Slovakia; foreign companies may be reviewed
cells.payout: Monthly default; daily or weekly available

fee.math: Foreign companies can apply, but no card rate for US sellers is published.
Foreign companies can apply, but no card rate for UK sellers is published.
Foreign companies can apply, but no card rate for German sellers is published.
